-- Sources of the types: scripts/srm21/INVENTORY.txt (machine-generated by Tests/Compiler/Srm21InventoryTest.lean, run i1 exit 0).

-- READING.  QDepthLift raw D b (Tests/Compiler/Srm20BridgeTest.lean:79): from ResetNk 1 raw D kids1 a ResetNk 2 raw D kids2 whose depth-2 run of (checkedOptimize b).body is its depth-1 run from kids1.
-- Why it can hold: depth-2 steps an instance (child gc1) with succKS (KSn 1) -- gc1's instances (grandchildren gc2) are stepped by KSn 1 = succKS flatKS -- while depth-1 steps gc1 with succKS flatKS -- its grandchildren by flatKS.
-- For an instance-free gc2, KSn 1 gc2 and flatKS gc2 compute the same environment and the same (st, mems).  So only the GRANDCHILDREN of the shipped body need be instance-free.

-- ===== (P1) real-data Prop: the grandchildren are instance-free (stated on D.modules through childMap, NOT a restatement of QDepthLift) =====
def GrandInstFree (D : Sparkle.IR.AST.Design) (body : List Sparkle.IR.AST.Stmt) : Prop :=
  ∀ (mn1 i1 : String) (c1 : List (String × Sparkle.IR.AST.Expr)) (gc1 : Sparkle.IR.AST.Module) (w1 : Sparkle.IR.Semantics.WEnv),
    Sparkle.IR.AST.Stmt.inst mn1 i1 c1 ∈ body → childMap D.modules mn1 = some (gc1, w1) →
    ∀ (mn2 i2 : String) (c2 : List (String × Sparkle.IR.AST.Expr)) (gc2 : Sparkle.IR.AST.Module) (w2 : Sparkle.IR.Semantics.WEnv),
      Sparkle.IR.AST.Stmt.inst mn2 i2 c2 ∈ gc1.body → childMap D.modules mn2 = some (gc2, w2) → instFree gc2.body

-- P1 for the shipped body (run agreement, P2) and for the CORE body `raw` (ResetNk 1/2 range over raw.body, P3)
def QGrandInstFree (raw : Sparkle.IR.AST.Module) (D : Sparkle.IR.AST.Design) (b : Sparkle.IR.AST.Module) : Prop :=
  GrandInstFree D (checkedOptimize b).body ∧ GrandInstFree D raw.body

-- correspondence used by P2 / P3 (depth-2 state vs depth-1 state of an instance; depth-1 grandchild state vs depth-0 grandchild state): registers and memories equal
def GkCorr (g2 : KT 1) (g1 : KT 0) : Prop := KState.st g2 = KidState.st g1 ∧ KState.mems g2 = KidState.mems g1
def KidCorr (k2 : KT 2) (k1 : KT 1) : Prop := KState.st k2 = KState.st k1 ∧ KState.mems k2 = KState.mems k1 ∧ ∀ gi : String, GkCorr (KState.kids k2 gi) (KState.kids k1 gi)

-- ===== (P2) run agreement from (P1) via instFree-run lemmas =====
theorem runModuleTG_depth2_depth1_of_grandInstFree (D : Sparkle.IR.AST.Design) (b : Sparkle.IR.AST.Module)
    (hf : GrandInstFree D (checkedOptimize b).body)
    (kids2 : String → KT 2) (kids1 : String → KT 1) (hc : ∀ i, KidCorr (kids2 i) (kids1 i))
    (seed : Nat → (String → Nat) → Sparkle.IR.Semantics.Env) (T : Nat) (st0 : String → Nat) (mems : Sparkle.IR.Semantics.MEnv) :
    runModuleTG (KSn (childMap D.modules) 2) (declWidth (checkedOptimize b)) (childMap D.modules) (checkedOptimize b).body seed T (⟨st0, mems, kids2⟩ : KState (KT 2)) =
    runModuleTG (KSn (childMap D.modules) 1) (declWidth (checkedOptimize b)) (childMap D.modules) (checkedOptimize b).body seed T (⟨st0, mems, kids1⟩ : KState (KT 1))

-- ===== (P3) the ResetNk depth lift =====
theorem resetNk_depth_lift (raw : Sparkle.IR.AST.Module) (D : Sparkle.IR.AST.Design) (hf : GrandInstFree D raw.body)
    (kids1 : String → KT 1) (h : ResetNk 1 raw D kids1) :
    ∃ kids2 : String → KT 2, ResetNk 2 raw D kids2 ∧ ∀ i, KidCorr (kids2 i) (kids1 i)

-- ===== (P4) QDepthLift from (P1)+(P2)+(P3) =====
theorem qDepthLift_of_grandInstFree (raw : Sparkle.IR.AST.Module) (D : Sparkle.IR.AST.Design) (b : Sparkle.IR.AST.Module)
    (h : QGrandInstFree raw D b) : QDepthLift raw D b

-- ===== (P1/P4 topshareQ instance) the source facts: ModCorr gQ + SRM7 computed ranks (gQ_top = 2, wrapP/wrapQ = 1, leafP = 0, memory = 0) =====
theorem topshareQ_grandInstFree  -- premises = those of Srm12CorrTest.topshareQ_corr (O T hA hR0 hcl entry₁ entry₂ entry hcore hpost hw)
    : QGrandInstFree raw D b
theorem topshareQ_qDepthLift     -- same premises
    : QDepthLift raw D b
